description: Returns the A2A workshop room's public scoreboard, the same data the /workshop/live screen shows: how many people enrolled, how many of the room's skills are covered, the recipe, every skill's public manifest, the winner (display name and time only) and the join URL. No auth required. Args: none. Returns { ok, workshop, enrolled, skills_count, skills_covered, recipe, skills[], winner|null, join_url }.
name: ic_workshop_status
title: Read the workshop room's scoreboard (public)
